about.title: About Us
about.p1: Atena School was born from the passion for languages and the desire to create a stimulating and welcoming environment where every student can feel at home. Our mission is to make language learning an engaging and accessible experience for everyone.
about.p2: Founded in Cittanova, Calabria, the school offers English courses for every level, preparation for Cambridge certifications and much more. Our qualified teachers use innovative methods to guarantee concrete results.

testimonials.quote: "Thanks to Atena School, I have improved my English incredibly. The environment is fantastic and the teachers are very prepared and helpful. I recommend it to everyone!"
testimonials.author: Maria R., Student
